content.user_title: Manage Google Docs with the gws CLI
content.value_statement: Google Docs automation can require precise API commands and request formats. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through gws document operations.
actual_capabilities: Shows the base gws command structure for Google Docs resources and methods.
Documents create, get, and batchUpdate operations for documents.
Directs users to inspect command help before selecting a method.
Uses gws schema output to identify required parameters, types, and defaults.
Links to the companion writing helper for appending document text.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated gws CLI.
Covers only the listed Google Docs v1 document operations.
The create operation makes a blank document and ignores supplied content fields.
Does not provide complete request payloads because schemas must be inspected first.

use_cases.title: Retrieve documents for support
use_cases.description: Inspect the get method and prepare a command that retrieves the latest version of a specified document.

use_cases.title: Create workflow documents
use_cases.description: Create blank Google Docs with approved titles as part of a repeatable operational workflow.

use_cases.title: Build document updates
use_cases.description: Inspect batchUpdate requirements before constructing validated document changes for an automation pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Docs commands
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the available gws Docs resources and explain which listed document method fits my goal: [GOAL].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs to choose an operation.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve a document
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the schema for the get method, then prepare a command to retrieve document [DOCUMENT_ID]. Explain each required flag.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs the latest document version.

prompt_templates.title: Create a blank document
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the create method schema and prepare a command that creates a blank document titled [TITLE].
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs a new named document.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a batch update
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the batchUpdate schema and outline a validated request for document [DOCUMENT_ID] that applies these changes: [CHANGES].
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs a multi-change document operation.

output_examples.input: Create a document titled Weekly Operations Review.
output_examples.output: The assistant inspects the create schema, identifies required fields, and prepares the title-based operation for a blank document.

output_examples.input: Retrieve the latest version of my document.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for the document identifier, checks the get schema, and explains the required parameters before retrieval.

output_examples.input: Apply several formatting and text changes together.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the batchUpdate schema, organizes the changes in order, and warns that one invalid request rejects the complete batch.

best_practices: Inspect each method schema before building parameters or request data.
Confirm document identifiers, titles, and intended changes before executing write operations.
Validate every batch request because one invalid item causes the complete update to fail.
anti_patterns: Do not guess parameter names, types, or defaults.
Do not expect the create operation to insert supplied document content.
Do not execute document changes without confirming the target document and requested edits.

faq.question: Which Google Docs operations are covered?
faq.answer: The skill documents create, get, and batchUpdate operations for the documents resource.

faq.question: Does this skill require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and configured using the shared authentication guidance.

faq.question: Can it create a document with initial content?
faq.answer: The documented create method makes a blank document. Use a separate update or writing operation to add content.

faq.question: How are required parameters discovered?
faq.answer: Inspect the method with gws schema before preparing parameter and request flags.

faq.question: What happens when one batch request is invalid?
faq.answer: The complete batch fails, and none of its requested changes are applied.

faq.question: Can it append text to a document?
faq.answer: The skill links to the companion writing helper, which is intended for appending text.
